summary: V50.z340 theme system tested end-to-end. Theme picker live-preview + Apply flow validated across all 4 themes (Luce/Pearl/Slate/Midnight). Tour skipped via [data-testid=tour-skip]. Full Slate→Midnight flow: tap theme-option-midnight showed theme-live-preview-midnight and theme-apply button with correct text 'Applica tema Midnight'; theme-active-slate remained (active tick NOT changed until apply); after tap theme-apply reload landed on axon_theme_last=midnight and theme-active-midnight tick. Reverse Midnight→Slate and Slate→Light→Slate also worked. Visited /master, /report, /contatti, /axon-alarms, /email-config, /impostazioni, /help-center, /callback/new, /contact/new, /appointment/new in Midnight — no red screens, no JS console errors, backgrounds dark. Visited /master, /report, /contact/new in Light — backgrounds light, forms readable. Final theme reset to Slate as requested. NOTE: could not enumerate testIDs for contact-list rows (used a different prefix) so tab-bills / tab-contracts inside a contact detail were only partially reached; the contact-list itself rendered correctly in midnight (dark cards, cyan text). NOTE: /api/me/theme returned {'detail':'Invalid token'} when hit from client localStorage; token is stored under a non-'token' key (SecureStore/other) — behavioral validation of persisted theme relies on axon_theme_last localStorage value which correctly matches the applied theme after each reload. Login on RN-Web Pressable required synthetic PointerEvents (pointerdown/pointerup/click) — Playwright .click() alone was ignored by RN Web Pressable. This is a test harness quirk, not an app bug.

issues: When the current theme is already the active one, the live-preview card is shown but theme-apply is intentionally hidden. Spec is satisfied but consider showing a disabled 'Tema già attivo' button so the mini-preview isn't ambiguous.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props deprecated warnings emitted on every screen; migrate to boxShadow/textShadow CSS. Also 'props.pointerEvents deprecated - use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: multiple screens, console warnings only (no crash).
'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' warnings on every screen; expected on web preview.

action_items: OPTIONAL: expose the JWT under a stable localStorage key on web (currently unknown key) so E2E tests can verify /api/me/theme without probing every LS entry.
OPTIONAL: make login Pressable also react to synthetic MouseEvent click without pointerdown/pointerup (helps future automated tests).
OPTIONAL: contact-list rows need a stable testID prefix (e.g. contact-row-<id>) to enable tab-bills / tab-contracts tests to open a contact reliably.
critical_code_review_comments: themes.ts palette values match spec (#0d0d14 / #13131e for midnight, #f5f7fa card for light).
resolveInitial() reads localStorage synchronously before StyleSheets are created — correct pattern for RN Web + Metro.
normalizeThemeId() migrates legacy 'grey' -> 'slate' and 'dark' -> 'midnight' — good backward compat.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow on RN Web Pressable buttons requires synthetic PointerEvents (pointerdown+pointerup+click) via page.evaluate; standard Playwright .click() is dropped. Store this TAP helper in test files. axon_theme_last localStorage key holds the applied theme; watch it to verify the reload path. To find contact list row testIDs, look at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/contatti.tsx — the testID pattern differs from 'contact-row-<id>'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug found. All flows in scope worked: theme picker, live-preview, Applica, persistence via axon_theme_last, reload lands on same route via RoutePersistence. No red screens on any of the 10 requested Midnight routes and the 3 requested Light routes.
